models.name: ecosystem service value
models.summary: The service value of a region is the area of each ecosystem times its value coefficient, then multiplied by a correction that compares the region with the national average.

constraints: each ecosystem is valued per unit area

models.name: sensitivity index
models.summary: The sensitivity is the relative change in the service value divided by the relative change in the value coefficient, and a result below one is read as inelastic.
models.purpose: test whether the value depends too much on one coefficient
objectives: judge the robustness of the valuation
constraints: the coefficient is shifted by a stated percentage
assumptions: a ratio below one means the valuation is inelastic

constraints: the same value is scaled two ways
assumptions: area and income are the two fair denominators
